narrative.details:
Have you noticed the abandoned camp to the south of here? It looks like the wildkin went crazy and destroyed just about everything they could find!

I heard a rumor that one of the survivors of the attack is resting at Starfall Village, west of here. I'm sure curious about what happened... aren't you?
narrative.objectives: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Aye, what can I do for you?
